description: Real JOINs on strait-1 with the shipped config: air and ground units spawn at the sanctuary and move along their routes for 10 game minutes; rejects for a unit in sortie, an unknown node, a node no road reaches and an unplayable role (NX-122). Aircraft without a target stay landed; the strike jet orbits east-airbase, then RTBs at bingo fuel and lands at west-airbase (NX-368).
